evidence.en: To explain the large military presence at the Regional Hospital, they alleged the cause as the exhumation of a young man's body that had hanged himself in jail. According to the exhumation report, this occurred on January 30, 1996; the activity took place on January 20, 21, and 22. No one could explain why the Army was monitoring this "exhumation."

In (MG), regarding a peculiar occurrence that suggests something unusual, the fact that the rumor spread so rapidly—to the point where it's now impossible to talk about anything else in the region—is itself a testament to the power of rumor.
